edit.description: place_settings_only also places the modeline per governed frontmatter artifact

summary: An unrepresented install places the yaml-language-server modeline pointing at the SDK's version-pinned CDN schema, writing nothing else

per.section: The placements and their enforcement modes

acceptance: temper install on an unrepresented harness seats a modeline naming the version-pinned CDN URL of the SDK's schema for each governed frontmatter artifact, idempotently
tests: an unrepresented install places a version-pinned CDN schema modeline in a governed frontmatter artifact
re-running an unrepresented install leaves the CDN schema modeline unchanged
pins: an unrepresented install writes no schema file to the tree
notes: 0109 Consequences: the CDN URL grammar (jsDelivr or unpkg) is cited at the point of claim when this is built; fetch the CDN's docs. The pinned version is the engine's own, which version_parity holds equal to the SDK's. A frontmatterless artifact takes no modeline.
